description: This file declares the interface IController within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The interface includes methods for managing controller state, configuration, environment, rebooting, and cloning, and it is marked as deprecated. It references external dependencies such as Module.h and relies on Core::IUnknown.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: A deprecated interface for controller operations, providing methods for persistent state management, configuration, environment retrieval, reboot, and cloning.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state of the controller.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified path or resource.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables or settings associated with an index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a controller or configuration based on a base callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
